senses.gloss:
ख्या ख्या, ii. 2, Par. Pass. To be known, MBh. 3, 8384.
 ख्यात, Knowṇ, Rām. 3, 22, 32.
 --Caus. ख्यापय,
 1. To proclaim, MBh. 5, 7403.
 2. To report, MBh. 3, 15697.
 3. To praise, Rām. 3, 27, 19.
 --With the prep. अभि अभि, अभिख्यात, Known, MBh. 13, 4644.
 --Caus. To proclaim, Man. 9, 262.
 --With आ आ,
 1. To report, MBh. 1, 26.
 2. To announce, Rām. 2, 34, 1.
 3. To name, Man. 4, 6.
 --Comp. ptcple. of the fut. pass., अन्-आ-ख्येय,
 1. Not to be reported, Pañc. 19, 16.
 2. unutterable, Bhartṛ. 1, 51.
 --Caus. To proclaim, MBh. 1, 7485.
 --With उपा उप-आ, To report, Bhāg. P. 2, 9, 45.
 --With प्रत्या प्रति-आ,
 1. To repudiate, Rām. 3, 54, 21.
 2. To recant, Daśak. in Chr. 192, 13.
 3. To surpass, Mālav. d. 40.
 --With व्या वि-आ, To explain, MBh. 1, 53.
 --With समा सम्-आ,
 1. To reckon up, Arj. 5, 11.
 2. To add, [] Man. 7, 156.
 3. To report, MBh. 3, 11915.
 --With परि परि, परिख्यात,
 1. Known, MBh. 1, 874.
 2. Famed, Rām. 3, 62, 2.
 3. Named, Rām. 5, 2, 4.
 --With प्र प्र,
 1. To report, Bhāg. P. 1, 5, 40. Pass. To shine, Rām. 5, 18, 4.
 प्रख्यात,
 1. Acknowledged, Man. 8, 399.
 2. Renowned, Rām. 3, 23, 39.
 --Caus. To make generally known, Kathās. 1, 61.
 --With वि वि, विख्यात,
 1. Generally known, Yājñ. 3, 301.
 2. Renowned, Rām. 3, 55, 16.
 3. Named, Rām. 1, 57, 10.
 --Caus. To proclaim, Man. 11, 83.
 --With अभिवि अभि-वि, अभिविख्यात,
 1. Renowned, Rām. 4, 1, 22.
 2. Named, MBh. 1, 2644.
 --With प्रवि प्र-वि, प्रविख्यात,
 1. Renowned, MBh. 1, 2543.
 2. Named, Mārk. P. 1, 26.
 --With सम् सम्,
 1. To sum up, MBh. 3, 2822.
 2. To calculate, Rām. 2, 40, 15.
 संख्यात, n. Number, Bhāg. P. 6, 14, 3.
 --Comp. ptcple. of the fut. pass., अ-संख्येय, adj. uncountable, Rām. 1, 1, 91.
 --With अभिसम् अभि-सम्, To reckon up, Rām. 4, 47, 4; 6, 1, 5.
 --With परिसम् परि-सम्, To add together, Man. 1, 71.
 --With प्रसम् प्र-सम्,
 1. To number, MBh. 1, 2547.
 --Cf. Goth. gôds (= ख्यात; the original signification of the vb. is probably ‘to shine’); A.S. gôd; ἀ-γαθός where ἀ = Sskt. स.

ख्याति ख्या + ति, f.
 1. Fame, celebrity, Man. 12, 36; personified, Bhāg. P. 3, 24, 22.
 2. Name, MBh. 1, 3180.
 3. Knowledge, Yogas. 2, 26.
 --Comp.
ख्यातिमन्त् ख्याति + मन्त्, adj. f. मती, Renowned, Kathās. 17, 34.
ऽख्यापक -ख्यापक, i. e. ख्या, [] Caus., + अक, adj. Foreboding, Suśr. 1, 127, 12.

ख्यापन ख्यापन, i. e. ख्या, Caus., + अन, n.
 1. Report, Chr. 55, 2.
 2. Confession, Man. 11, 227.
 3. Making renowned, Rājat. 5, 160.
ख्यात-व्याकरण- + श्रम ख्यात-व्याकरण- + श्रम, m. renowned for his study of grammar, Rājat. 5, 29.
